evidence.name: Screen field: Header Bar Background
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Header Bar Background" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Header Bar Background
sections.description: Fills the header bar with a color, or clear it to transparent so the screen background shows through for a floating header. Use a solid color to set the header apart from busy content. If you go transparent over a photo or video, check that the Back, Skip, and progress colors still stand out clearly.
